title: Operational Graphify layer for EQCOFE
description: Promote Graphify from installed developer tooling to an operational repository-local code intelligence layer: define the canonical graph architecture, add graph freshness/health checks, state recording, incremental refresh and watch launchers, and bind Codex local-agent behavior to graph-first/staleness-aware operation. No runtime application behavior, backend/frontend feature, database, dependency, CI workflow, branch protection, or production behavior changes.

evidence.synchronization_reason: Step 61-I canonical closure merged before Graphify operational-layer closure

acceptance_criteria.description: Repository defines exactly one canonical repository-wide Graphify graph at graphify-out/; focused subgraphs are disposable local caches, not source of truth.
Graph health command reports graph presence, parseability, node/edge counts, recorded graph HEAD and stale/fresh state against current Git HEAD.
Incremental refresh launcher updates the canonical graph, records exact Git HEAD metadata, and runs health verification.
Watch launcher monitors code changes with Graphify debounce and uses the persisted Graphify interpreter/root when available.
Codex repository instructions enforce graph-first query, freshness check, stale refresh, focused source read, mutation, tests, graph refresh, verification.
Generated Task Catalog is exactly reconciled with this Task Contract.
No runtime application, backend/frontend, database, dependency, workflow, or branch-protection behavior changes are introduced.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Provider risk classification is authoritative; HIGH escalation requires Security and Owner Human Gate.
